thread:
sophia: Heads up — trying to allocate +8 A100s to tenant `ai-recs` for Friday loadtest. Vendor says they need proxy creds + telemetry tag to attach reservations. ETA still TBD. Anyone have the proxy key or a quick quota check? cc @matt

matt: I can run a quick quota check — hold on. which region?

sophia: eu-west1 pls. vendor specifically asked for `reserve_id` and `project` plus header `x-telemetry:ci-loadtest`.

matt: running: `gcloud compute reservations list --filter="region:eu-west1 AND name~'redwood-reserve'"` -> shows 12 free GPUs. We have 4 already reserved in the dedicated pool; looks like we can carve 8 but vendor needs creds to attach. I'll DM vendor-proxy creds.

raj: vendor will ask for a service account key with `roles/compute.admin`. we should NOT hand long-lived SA keys to external vendors. suggestion: create an ephemeral SA key scoped to `staging-vendor-attach` with TTL 6h and audit logs. @procurement-bot can you approve ephemeral SA flow?

procurement-bot: Approval required: create ephemeral SA `vendor-attach-eu-west1` with `compute.admin`, TTL 6h, audit logging ON. Reply `approve` to proceed.

lisa: +1 to ephemeral SA. also ensure we set the telemetry header so billing/telemetry labels the attach as `ci-loadtest`. i'll prep a tiny terraform snippet to create the SA and the key.

lisa: Terraform snippet (draft):
```hcl
resource "google_service_account" "vendor_attach" {
  account_id   = "vendor-attach-eu-west1"
  display_name = "Ephemeral vendor attach SA"
}
resource "google_service_account_key" "ephemeral_key" {
  service_account_id = google_service_account.vendor_attach.name
  keepers = { rotate = timestamp() }
}
```

matt: I shared creds with vendor via 1Password, item `vendor/ephemeral/eu-west1/1729123456` :lock: — will revoke after attach.

sophia: Nice. any ETA from vendor on the attach step?

procurement-bot: Vendor update: ETA ~3h, queued behind one other attach. will post when attach completes.

oncall-bot: Note: tagging this thread with `#standby-alloc` for postmortem/audit tracking.

raj: linking runbook: https://internal/runbooks/attach-vendor — if vendor stalls >4h we fallback to `preemptible-blend` plan in the runbook.

sophia: Perfect. i'll update the ticket and close when done. thanks all :thumbsup:
